messages:
Alex Turner: Hey sec team — telemetry flagged a set of partner delivery logs that contain KMS-wrapped ciphertexts and what looks like embedded request blobs. Not sure if any plain keys leaked, but we should treat this as suspected exposure and do a coordinated sweep + rotation. Details in the lines below. :rotating_light:
Maya Kapoor: Can you paste the S3 path and a sample log line?
Alex Turner: Path: s3://partner-batch-deliveries/2026-03-20/part-0003.gz
Sample snippet: 
```
{"ts":"2026-03-20T14:12:03Z","request_id":"r-abc123","payload":"ENCRYPTED-BLOB","x-kms-key-id":"projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/wrap-keys/cryptoKeys/rdw-wrap"}
```
Maya Kapoor: Thanks. That KMS key is our production wrapping key. If partner infra allowed logs to capture request bodies, they may have stored ciphertexts but not plain. Still need to be conservative.
sec-bot: Incident created INC-2026-459. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cred-leak-sweep (assigned priority P2 until we confirm unwrap).
Samir Patel: Quick triage notes: 1) If only ciphertexts leaked then rotating the wrapping key + rewrapping stored objects reduces blast radius. 2) We must revoke any SA that had Decrypt permission on the wrapping key until we validate. 3) Enable detailed KMS audit (CryptoKeyAccess events) and backfill.
Jordan Li: I'll apply a short scoped deny for roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter to the partner service account in prod for 30m to give us breathing room. Will report when applied.
Maya Kapoor: Also opened a PR to stop the telemetry pipeline from copying raw request blobs into partner artifacts. PR: https://github.com/redwood/telemetry/pull/789 (contains scrub + masking).
Alex Turner: Who will own rewrap of artifacts and Vault transit mapping? We need a script that: 1) creates a new key version or new key, 2) fetches ciphertexts, 3) unwraps with old key, 4) rewraps with new key, 5) verifies integrity. Example gcloud rewrap command for testing: 
```
# create new key version
gcloud kms keys versions create --key=my-wrap-key --location=global --keyring=wrap-keys
# test rewrap (local sample blob)
gcloud kms decrypt --location global --keyring wrap-keys --key rdw-wrap --ciphertext-file=blob.ct --plaintext-file=blob.pt
gcloud kms encrypt --location global --keyring wrap-keys --key rdw-wrap-v2 --plaintext-file=blob.pt --ciphertext-file=blob_new.ct
```
Samir Patel: I'll take the rewrap job and sweep for derived tokens. Plan: run on a safe staging slice first, verify hashes, then roll to prod. I'll also rotate any Vault transit keys that reference the wrapping key mapping.
sec-bot: Audit changes queued: enable KMS Admin audit logs for 90d retention, add watcher for CryptoKeyAccess.* events. Ticket: AUDIT-2026-88.
Jordan Li: IAM deny applied to partner SA (scoped) at 2769998120. Monitoring for any unexpected failures — ping me if services break.
Samir Patel: Rewrap job started at 2769998200 against a staging sample, smoke tests passing. Will promote to prod after 30m verification.
Maya Kapoor: PR merged; pipeline no longer copies raw request blobs to partner artifacts. :lock:
Alex Turner: Action roundup — Jordan: keep the short deny and confirm rollback window, Samir: complete rewrap + rotate Vault transit mapping, Maya: confirm scrub and run a reingest test, Alex: notify partner/legal + open support escalation. ETA for initial containment: 2h from thread start.
Alex Turner: Followup: schedule Vault transit key rotation tomorrow 2026-03-21 09:00 UTC (change window + rollback steps in runbook). Everyone please add post-mortem notes to INC-2026-459. :thumbsup:
